verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm combined with a case-tracking client portal, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes external tools. Plugging in MCP servers as a client is an agent-role capability, so the axis is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows an AI agent surface that could act as an MCP client; the probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs, or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
